name: target_type comment: 圈选类型 category品类/brand品牌/listing指定商品 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_id comment: 目标ID（对应category_id/brand_id/listing_id） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_code comment: 优惠码 note: 仅 trigger_type=code 使用；一规则可多码做定向发放 columns: - name: id comment: 优惠码ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_id comment: 规则ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 优惠码字符串 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/disabled constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: used_count comment: 该码已使用次数（冗余计数） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_redemption comment: 核销流水 note: 仅计数不记金额（金额归订单 order_discount）。判限次：总量看规则used_count、每人看(rule,user)、码级看code_id columns: - name: id comment: 核销ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_id comment: 规则ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code_id comment: 优惠码ID（自动折扣为空） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: redeemed_at comment: 核销时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_product comment: 商品域（引用） note: 圈选活动商品时只读；商品折扣命中维度 columns: - name: listing_id comment: 在售商品ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spu_id comment: SPU ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: category_id comment: 品类ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand_id comment: 品牌ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_market comment: market（引用） note: 规则投放市场、币种口径来源 columns: - name: market_id comment: 市场ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_user comment: 用户（引用） note: 核销归属用户，每人限次判定 columns: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_order comment: 订单-优惠记录（引用） note: order_discount.promotion_ref_id → promotion_rule.id；金额明细归订单模块 columns: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_ref_id comment: 促销规则ID（指向rule） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: discount_amount comment: 优惠金额（订单模块管） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: promotion_rule to: promotion type: N:1 label: 归属活动 penwidth: 1.6 - from: promotion_market to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 投放市场 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_target to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 圈选商品 - from: promotion_code to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 优惠码 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 核销 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion_code type: N:1 label: 码核销 - from: promotion_market to: ref_market type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_target to: ref_product type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_user type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_order type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: ref_order to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 规则快照引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed design_rules: 活动-规则-码三层: 活动=分组容器；折扣规则=规则真正载体(聚合根)；优惠码=有码触发凭证。一活动多规则、一规则多码 触发方式: promotion_rule.trigger_type=auto时无码自动生效；=code时挂1~N个promotion_code由用户输码触发 金额不重复建: 营销只管规则与核销计数；每单实际让利金额与行级分摊归订单模块 order_discount / order_discount_item 订单侧契约: order_discount.promotion_ref_id 指向 promotion_rule.id，promotion_name 存 rule_name 快照 多币种录值: 固定金额折扣值与满额门槛按 promotion_market 逐市场币种录入，无实时汇率换算；百分比值全市场统一 用量控制: 总次数看 rule.used_count、每人次数看(rule_id,user_id)计数、码级看 code_id、有效期看活动 start_at/end_at 互斥取优_V1: 同一订单多规则命中时取对用户最优的一个；combines_with 预留 Shopify 组合类模型，V2 放开叠加 V2预留: budget_total/budget_spent(金额预算池)、阶梯门槛、eligibility(人群定向)、活动维度聚合统计 均本版不落逻辑 范围_V1: 仅平台运营创建；折扣成本默认平台承担；三方商家自主营销为后续版本
